column1: # clues.tsv for ft_str_is_printable — hints only, never answers.
Which byte values are "printable", and why does an empty string return 1? Recall the contiguous band of printable ASCII.

Are newline and tab printable, or control characters? Which byte sits just below space, and which just above '~': does your function accept either? And a byte above 127: what value does it have in a plain char, and does your test let it through?
